main.description: Encrypted drives only. A device that holds the drive's keys, or asks for them, keyed by the device's ID (a TID). Not sealed as a whole: a device asks before it has the keys, and the others read its public key to wrap the keyring for it. One more record, key 'recovery', holds only recoveryKeyring. All of them are deleted when encryption is turned off.

name.description: The device's name, for the pairing prompt, while it waits to be approved. Approving it drops this: the name shown from then on is the one sealed in member, so the PDS doesn't see what the drive's devices are called.

publicKey.description: The device's raw X25519 public key.

keyring.description: The drive's keyring, wrapped for this device. Absent while it waits to be approved.

member.description: That this device is approved: {id, name, publicKey}, sealed with the drive's current key for this record. Devices wrap new keys only for devices whose member opens, and take keyrings only from them. Absent while it waits.

approvedBy.description: The ID of the device that approved this one, if it wasn't itself.

recoveryKeyring.description: Only in the record with key 'recovery': the keyring wrapped with the recovery key.
